highlights.title: Voice input
highlights.line: Click the microphone in the composer, or hold ⇧⌘Space, to talk instead of typing; your words are written on your Mac, and nothing is sent until you send it.

highlights.title: Goals that keep going
highlights.line: Write `/goal all tests pass`, and the agent works turn after turn until a check says it's met.

highlights.title: What your agents made
highlights.line: A bot's Shelf keeps its pages, pictures and memory, with every change on its Timeline.

highlights.title: Answers you can try
highlights.line: Agents show charts, diagrams and things to click right in the conversation.

highlights.title: Settings that guide you
highlights.line: Pick folders, plugins and models from what's there instead of typing them.
